notes: Access route: direct freedomtree.in and www variant returned HTTP 429 'Verifying your connection...' (Cloudflare-style challenge) on every attempt, as did r.jina.ai. Reliable route was the translate.goog mirror (https://freedomtree-in.translate.goog/... , consistent HTTP 200), used for both HTML nav pages and Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json endpoints (JSON passes through the proxy unmodified). Site is Shopify-based. Per Rule 1, products_count was NOT trusted; every quantity was built by paginating products.json (limit=250) and deduping by numeric product ID. Freedom Tree's own nav collections heavily cross-list the same product across multiple named collections (e.g. Jugs & Carafes appear identically in both 'decorative-accents' and 'drinkware'; Centerpieces are split across 'decorative-accents', 'indoor-planters' and 'serving-trays-stands'), so all 11 candidate collections reachable from the 'Decor & Lighting' and 'Dining & Entertaining' nav panels were merged into one global unique-product-ID set (611 unique products) and then re-bucketed by the site's own product_type field, which eliminated all cross-listing double-counts. Excluded from that merged set: SCENTED CANDLES (14, Home Fragrance) and BAR TOOLS (2, bar tools) -- 595 in-scope products remain, matching the sum of all leaf qty below. Out-of-scope branches confirmed and excluded: Home Textiles (Textile Collections, Upholstery Fabric, Curtains & Sheers, Cushion Covers, Bed Linen, Rugs, Throws -- textiles, brand's core line per task brief), Flatware/Cutlery, Table Linen, Designer Wallpaper (explicitly excluded category), the entire Furniture nav panel (Seating, Beds, Tables, Storage, Shop by Room -- all furniture, no lighting/mirrors hidden inside it, verified by inspecting the panel), Clothing (apparel), and the promotional Sale/Gifting/New Arrivals/Featured collections (NEVER EXTRACT roll-up/promo pages per rules). Site-wide search (/search/suggest.json) for 'clock' and 'wall clock' returned zero products -- Freedom Tree has no Clocks category (empty scope confirmed by search, not just nav absence). Rule 0 check: no category was excluded for a room-name reason; all included categories are decor/tableware product types regardless of nav room labels. Duplicate-company check: grepped all archived c*.json files under the scratchpad root and the project's pipeline/json_archive folder for 'Freedom Tree' -- no prior entry found; this appears to be the first extraction for this company in the batch. This is a narrower, non-textile decor slice as anticipated in the task brief: Freedom Tree is primarily a printed-textile/cushion brand, and its decor-adjacent catalogue (lighting, mirrors, decorative accessories, tableware) totals 595 in-scope leaf-level items across 20 leaf rows.
